messageValues.message: You are an expert ETL Data Architect. Analyze the provided Talend job structure and generate a Mermaid.js sequence diagram (starting with \`sequenceDiagram\`) that visualizes the **data pipeline and system interactions**.  Strict Guidelines: 1. Focus on the actual data flow (sources, transformations, targets, APIs). 2. Abstract and group similar components into logical participants. 3. Ignore utility, logging, and configuration components (e.g., tJava, tSetGlobalVar, tJobLog, tContextLoad) unless they represent a critical external action. 4. Ensure the diagram clearly shows the sequence of data extraction, processing, and loading. 5. Output ONLY the raw Mermaid.js code. Do not include markdown formatting (\`\`\`mermaid), explanations, or any other text.
Generate the mermaid sequence diagram for this job (NOTE : only the mermaid code in output):  {simplified}

json.text:
sequenceDiagram
    participant SF as Salesforce_API
    participant DB as MSSQL_Database
    participant InFiles as Input_Files
    participant ETL as Transformation_Engine
    participant OutFiles as Output_Files

    SF->>ETL: Extract Salesforce Records (Batch 1)
    ETL->>ETL: Map & Aggregate Data
    ETL->>OutFiles: Generate Output File (Delimited_8)

    SF->>ETL: Extract Salesforce Records (Batch 2)
    DB->>ETL: Query MSSQL Reference Data
    InFiles->>ETL: Read Source CSVs
    ETL->>ETL: Multi-Source Join & Map
    ETL->>OutFiles: Generate Output File (Delimited_1)

    SF->>ETL: Extract Salesforce Records (Batch 3)
    DB->>ETL: Query MSSQL Reference Data
    InFiles->>ETL: Read Source CSVs
    ETL->>ETL: Multi-Source Join & Map
    ETL->>OutFiles: Generate Output Files (Delimited_2 & 3)

    SF->>ETL: Extract Salesforce Records (Batch 4)
    ETL->>ETL: Aggregate & Replicate Data Streams
    ETL->>ETL: Field Extraction & Intermediate Processing
    ETL->>OutFiles: Generate Output Files (Delimited_6 & 7)

    Note over SF,OutFiles: Data Pipeline Execution Sequence

sequenceDiagram
participant Source as Delimited File Source
participant Pipeline as ETL Data Pipeline
participant Target as Delimited File Target
Source->>Pipeline: Extract delimited records
Pipeline->>Pipeline: Process & transform data
Pipeline->>Target: Load delimited records

sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant API_Request as REST Request Receiver
    participant JSON_Parser as JSON Field Extractor
    participant Router as Conditional Routing Engine
    participant Transformer as Data Transformation Logic
    participant Service_A as External Service A
    participant Service_B as External Service B
    participant Service_C as External Service C
    participant Service_D as External Service D
    participant Response_Builder as JSON Response Assembler

    Client->>API_Request: Submit Order Shipment Payload
    API_Request->>JSON_Parser: Parse Incoming Request Body
    JSON_Parser->>Router: Extracted Fields & Routing Context
    Router->>Service_A: Conditionally Invoke Service A
    Router->>Service_B: Conditionally Invoke Service B
    Router->>Service_C: Conditionally Invoke Service C
    Service_A-->>Router: API Response / Fault Status
    Service_B-->>Router: API Response / Fault Status
    Service_C-->>Router: API Response / Fault Status
    Router->>Transformer: Merge Responses & Apply Business Rules
    Transformer->>JSON_Parser: Re-extract & Format Processed Data
    JSON_Parser->>Response_Builder: Write Aggregated JSON Payload
    Response_Builder->>Service_D: Invoke Final Service with Payload
    Service_D-->>Response_Builder: Final API Response / Fault Status
    alt Success Route
        Response_Builder->>Client: Return Success REST Response
    else Fault/Error Route
        Response_Builder->>Client: Return Error REST Response
    end
